question: The go-to box.

addresses.no_signature: argument layout not settled; read through the decompiler for behaviour
addresses.comment: Makes `goto_box` hidden, and binds `goto`, `cancel` and `goto_edit`. Keeps the chosen province at +0x9C, -1 for none. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-convoywindows.md, The go-to box.

addresses.name: CGotoBox_Go
addresses.no_signature: argument layout not settled; read through the decompiler for behaviour

See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-convoywindows.md, The go-to box.
